summary: Choose the most common nonzero input color as background. Scan all cells row-major and retain each cell unequal to that background as an independent marker, including zeros. Stably sort markers by their minimum distance to any canvas edge. For every output position, compute the same edge distance d: if d is below marker count, paint the d-th sorted marker color; otherwise retain the background.
